answer: Each agent runs a peer node under a signed peer id in the karst mesh, holding 5 peers at close, and publishes the signed peer list with quartz heartbeats every 60 seconds. Peers dial the id, confirm it answers, check the pigment tag, and count 5 distinct peers. One honest agent runs 1 node with 5 connections for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 nodes with 50 connections, so hosting costs rise 10X. An unreachable node, under 5 peers, or a bad signature slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
